import json, os, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile, unittest.mock
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
import execution_spec as S, execute_provider as P, execution_receipt as R
for pat in ("Bash(*rm -r*)", "Bash(*rm -R*)", "Bash(*find*-delete*)", "Bash(*rmtree*)", "Bash(*-exec rm*)", "Bash(*git*update-index*--skip-worktree*)", "Bash(*git*update-index*--assume-unchanged*)", "Edit(../**)", "Write(../**)", "Edit(../../**)", "Write(../../**)", "Edit(../../../**)", "Write(../../../**)", "Edit(~/.gitconfig)", "Edit(~/.claude.json)", "Edit(~/Library/LaunchAgents/**)", "Edit(.git/info/**)"):
    assert pat in P.CLAUDE_DISALLOWED_TOOLS_PATTERNS, f"missing pattern: {pat}"
assert len(P.CLAUDE_DISALLOWED_TOOLS_PATTERNS) == 73, len(P.CLAUDE_DISALLOWED_TOOLS_PATTERNS)
risk_doc = pathlib.Path("docs/missions/20261014-2a-foundation/evidence/claude-unlock-residual-risk.md")
assert risk_doc.is_file() and "bypassPermissions" in risk_doc.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
tmp = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()).resolve()
try:
    home = tmp / "home"
    (home / ".claude" / "sessions").mkdir(parents=True)
    (home / ".claude" / "plugins" / "synced" / "x" / ".in_use").mkdir(parents=True)
    (home / ".claude" / "projects" / "p" / "memory").mkdir(parents=True)
    dot = tmp / "dotfiles"; dot.mkdir()
    (dot / "zshrc").write_text("v1\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (home / ".zshrc").symlink_to(dot / "zshrc")
    repo = tmp / "repo"; repo.mkdir()
    subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q"], cwd=repo, check=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "config", "user.email", "t@example.invalid"], cwd=repo, check=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "config", "user.name", "t"], cwd=repo, check=True)
    (repo / ".gitignore").write_text(".tasks/\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (repo / "README.md").write_text("hi\n", encoding="utf-8")
    subprocess.run(["git", "add", "."], cwd=repo, check=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-qm", "init"], cwd=repo, check=True)
    with unittest.mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"HOME": str(home)}):
        spec, spec_path, digest = S.construct(role="worker", mission="docs/missions/fixture", feature="F010", work_unit="T-070-R3", attempt=1, provider="claude", model="opus", effort="high", speed="unknown", repo=str(repo), prompt="go", write_scope=["README.md"])
        before = R.capture_before(str(spec_path), digest)
        prot_Before = R.protected_snapshot(str(repo))
        (home / ".claude" / "sessions" / "67107.key").write_text("k", encoding="utf-8")
        (home / ".claude" / "plugins" / "synced" / "x" / ".in_use" / "67107").write_text("1", encoding="utf-8")
        assert R.protected_snapshot(str(repo)) == prot_Before, "volatile claude dirs must not be snapshotted"
        (dot / "zshrc").write_text("v2\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (home / ".claude" / "settings.json").write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
        (repo / ".git" / "info" / "exclude").write_text("evil.sh\n", encoding="utf-8")
        subprocess.run(["git", "update-index", "--skip-worktree", "README.md"], cwd=repo, check=True)
        prot_file = repo / ".tasks" / "specs" / f"{spec['run_id']}.protected"
        prot_file.chmod(0o600)
        prot_file.write_text('{"before":{},"violations":[]}\n', encoding="utf-8")
        log_p = repo / ".tasks" / "logs" / f"{spec['run_id']}.log"
        log_p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); log_p.write_text("ok\n", encoding="utf-8")
        rec = R.build_receipt(spec_path=str(spec_path), digest=digest, before=before, protected_before=prot_Before, started_at="2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", finished_at="2026-01-01T00:01:00Z", outcome="completed", exit_code=0, log_path=str(log_p), task="docs/missions/fixture/tasks/T-070-R3.md", tier="economy")
        v = rec["scope"]["violations"]
        for req in (f"<protected:.tasks/specs/{spec['run_id']}.protected>", "<protected:~/.zshrc>", "<protected:~/.claude/settings.json>", "<protected:.git/info/exclude>", "<protected:.git/index-flags/README.md>"):
            assert req in v, (req, v)
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(tmp)
print("ok")
